/* Courts at home: compare origin countries by theme. Generated by build/origin-courts/origin_courts.py: do not edit by hand. */
(function () {
  var C = __DATA__;
  var S = {by: "sit", row: null, ord: "imp", law: null};
  var ORD = {imp: ["Most important first", "Paling penting lebih dahulu"], n: ["Most decisions first", "Putusan terbanyak lebih dahulu"]};
  var BY = {sit: ["Situation", "Situasi"], stage: ["Stage of the journey", "Tahap perjalanan"], branch: ["Type of case", "Jenis perkara"]};
  function L() { return (document.documentElement.lang || "en").slice(0, 2) === "id" ? 1 : 0; }
  function t(a) { return a[L()]; }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return {"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;"}[c]; }); }
  function rows() { return C.dims[S.by]; }
  function has(d, k) { var v = d[S.by === "sit" ? 4 : S.by === "stage" ? 5 : 6]; return Array.isArray(v) ? v.indexOf(k) >= 0 : v === k; }
  function render() {
    var root = document.getElementById("oc-courts"); if (!root) return;
    var l = L(), cs = C.countries;
    var h = '<div class="g-btns" role="group" aria-label="' + (l ? "Kelompokkan menurut" : "Group by") + '">' +
      Object.keys(BY).map(function (k) { return '<button type="button" class="g-btn" data-occby="' + k + '" aria-pressed="' + (S.by === k) + '">' + esc(t(BY[k])) + "</button>"; }).join("") + "</div>";
    if (S.by === "sit") h += '<div class="g-btns" role="group" aria-label="' + (l ? "Urutan" : "Order") + '">' + Object.keys(ORD).map(function (k) { return '<button type="button" class="g-btn" data-occord="' + k + '" aria-pressed="' + (S.ord === k) + '">' + esc(t(ORD[k])) + "</button>"; }).join("") + "</div>";
    h += '<div class="g-scroll"><table class="g-t"><thead><tr><th>' + esc(t(BY[S.by])) + "</th>" + cs.map(function (c) { return "<th>" + esc(t(c[1])) + "</th>"; }).join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    // most decisions first (oto, 18 November 2026); the stages keep the order of the journey
    var rs = rows().map(function (r, i) { return {r: r, i: i, counts: cs.map(function (c) { return C.d.filter(function (d) { return d[2] === c[0] && has(d, r[0]); }).length; })}; });
    rs.forEach(function (x) { x.n = x.counts.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0); x.k = x.counts.filter(function (v) { return v > 0; }).length; });
    var rank = function (k) { var i = C.rank.indexOf(k); return i < 0 ? 99 : i; };
    if (S.by === "sit" && S.ord === "imp") rs.sort(function (a, b) { return rank(a.r[0]) - rank(b.r[0]) || b.n - a.n || a.i - b.i; });
    else if (S.by !== "stage") rs.sort(function (a, b) { return b.n - a.n || b.k - a.k || a.i - b.i; });
    rs.forEach(function (x) {
      var r = x.r, counts = x.counts;
      var n = counts.filter(function (x) { return x > 0; }).length; if (!n) return;
      h += '<tr><th scope="row" style="position:static;background:none;font-size:15px;color:inherit"><button type="button" class="g-btn" data-occrow="' + esc(r[0]) + '" aria-pressed="' + (S.row === r[0]) + '">' + esc(t(r[1])) + "</button>" +
        ' <span class="g-note">' + x.n + (l ? " putusan" : x.n === 1 ? " decision" : " decisions") + (n > 1 ? (l ? ", " + n + " negara" : ", " + n + " countries") : "") + "</span>" + "</th>" +
        counts.map(function (x) { return "<td>" + (x ? x : '<span class="g-note">–</span>') + "</td>"; }).join("") + "</tr>";
    });
    h += "</tbody></table></div>";
    if (S.by === "sit" && S.ord === "imp") h += '<details style="margin:12px 0"><summary>' + (l ? "Mengapa urutan ini" : "Why this order") + '</summary><p class="g-note">' + esc(t(C.why.lead)) + '</p><ul style="padding-left:18px;line-height:1.5">' +
      C.why.items.map(function (x) { return "<li>" + esc(t(x.t)) + ' <a href="' + esc(x.u) + '" rel="noopener">' + esc(x.s) + "</a></li>"; }).join("") + "</ul></details>";
    var r = S.row && rows().filter(function (x) { return x[0] === S.row; })[0];
    if (r) {
      h += '<h3 style="margin:24px 0 8px">' + esc(t(r[1])) + ": " + (l ? "putusan dari tiap negara" : "decisions from each country") + "</h3>";
      h += '<div class="g-grid2">' + cs.map(function (c) {
        var ds = C.d.filter(function (d) { return d[2] === c[0] && has(d, r[0]); }); if (!ds.length) return "";
        ds.sort(function (a, b) { return String(b[3]).localeCompare(String(a[3])); });
        return '<div class="g-card"><h3>' + esc(t(c[1])) + ' <span class="g-note">(' + ds.length + ')</span></h3><ul style="padding-left:18px;line-height:1.5;max-height:420px;overflow:auto">' +
          ds.map(function (d) { return '<li><a href="/court-decisions/d/' + d[0] + '/">' + esc(d[1]) + '</a> <span class="g-note">' + esc(d[3] || "n.d.") + (d[7] === "C" ? (l ? " · belum diperiksa" : " · unchecked") : "") + "</span></li>"; }).join("") + "</ul></div>";
      }).join("") + "</div>";
    } else {
      h += '<p class="g-note">' + (l ? "Pilih satu baris untuk melihat putusan dari tiap negara secara berdampingan." : "Choose a row to see the decisions from each country side by side.") + "</p>";
    }
    h += gap(l) + law(l);
    root.innerHTML = h;
  }
  function gap(l) {
    var G = C.gap, lab = {}; C.dims.sit.forEach(function (r) { lab[r[0]] = r[1]; });
    var pct = function (a, b) { return (100 * a / b).toFixed(1).replace(".", l ? "," : ".") + "%"; };
    var h = '<h3 style="margin:36px 0 8px">' + (l ? "Apakah pengaduan sampai ke pengadilan?" : "Do complaints reach the courts?") + "</h3>";
    h += "<p>" + (l ? "Tabel ini menyandingkan urutan kepentingan tiap masalah (dari pengaduan dan kajian ILO, lihat \u201cMengapa urutan ini\u201d) dengan urutannya menurut jumlah putusan pengadilan di negara asal. Masalah yang penting tetapi jarang diputus pengadilan menunjukkan di mana pekerja kemungkinan tidak sampai ke pengadilan."
                    : "This table sets each problem's importance rank (from complaints and ILO studies, see \u201cWhy this order\u201d) beside its rank by the number of decisions of courts in countries of origin. A problem that matters a lot but rarely reaches a judgment shows where workers are likely not getting to court.") + "</p>";
    h += '<div class="g-scroll"><table class="g-t"><thead><tr><th>' + (l ? "Situasi" : "Situation") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Urutan kepentingan" : "Importance rank") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Putusan di negara asal" : "Decisions at home") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Urutan menurut putusan" : "Rank by decisions") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Pengaduan BP2MI 2024 (Indonesia)" : "BP2MI complaints 2024 (Indonesia)") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Bacaan" : "Reading") + "</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
    G.rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var d = r[2] - r[1], read = d >= 3 ? (l ? "Sedikit putusan dibanding kepentingannya" : "Few decisions for its importance") : d <= -3 ? (l ? "Banyak putusan dibanding kepentingannya" : "Many decisions for its importance") : (l ? "Sejalan" : "In line");
      var bp = r[4] ? r[4][0] + " (" + pct(r[4][0], G.bp_total) + ", " + (l ? r[4][2] : r[4][1]) + ")" : '<span class="g-note">–</span>';
      h += "<tr><td>" + esc(t(lab[r[0]] || [r[0], r[0]])) + "</td><td>" + r[1] + "</td><td>" + r[3] + " (" + pct(r[3], G.total) + ")</td><td>" + r[2] + "</td><td>" + bp + "</td><td>" + (d >= 3 || d <= -3 ? "<b>" + read + "</b>" : read) + "</td></tr>";
    });
    h += "</tbody></table></div>";
    h += '<p class="g-note">' + (l ? "Korelasi peringkat Spearman antara kepentingan dan jumlah putusan: \u03c1 = " + String(G.rho).replace(".", ",") + " (8 situasi). Angka yang mendekati 1 berarti pengadilan memutus masalah yang paling penting; angka di bawah 0 berarti sebaliknya. \u201cSedikit\u201d atau \u201cbanyak\u201d berarti kedua urutan berselisih tiga tingkat atau lebih. Pengaduan berasal dari Indonesia, sedangkan putusan sebagian besar berasal dari Filipina dan Nepal, dan sebagian besar putusan belum dibaca; jadi tabel ini menunjukkan arah kasar, bukan pengukuran. Angka BP2MI/KP2MI diambil dari Laporan Tahunan Publikasi Data PMI 2024."
                                  : "Spearman rank correlation between importance and number of decisions: \u03c1 = " + G.rho + " (8 situations). A value near 1 would mean the courts decide the problems that matter most; below 0 means the opposite. \u201cFew\u201d or \u201cmany\u201d means the two ranks differ by three places or more. The complaints come from Indonesia while most decisions come from the Philippines and Nepal, and most decisions have not yet been read, so the table shows a rough direction, not a measurement. The BP2MI/KP2MI figures are from its 2024 annual data report.") + "</p>";
    return h;
  }
  function law(l) {
    var L2 = C.law, cn = {}; C.countries.forEach(function (c) { cn[c[0]] = c[1]; });
    var h = '<h3 style="margin:36px 0 8px">' + (l ? "Hukum di atas kertas dan di pengadilan" : "Law on the books and in court") + "</h3>";
    h += "<p>" + (l ? "Untuk setiap undang-undang utama, tabel ini menyandingkan kode yang diberikan halaman ini (2, 1 atau 0) dengan jumlah putusan Mahkamah Agung yang teksnya menyebut undang-undang tersebut, per lima tahun. Kode menunjukkan apa yang dijanjikan hukum; jumlah putusan menunjukkan seberapa sering hukum itu sampai ke pengadilan tertinggi."
                    : "For each main statute, this table sets the codes this page gives it (2, 1 or 0) beside the number of Supreme Court decisions whose text names it, by five-year period. The codes show what the law promises; the decisions show how often it reaches the highest court.") + "</p>";
    var maxv = 1; L2.stat.forEach(function (st) { st.per.forEach(function (p) { if (p[1] > maxv) maxv = p[1]; }); });
    h += '<div class="g-scroll"><table class="g-t"><thead><tr><th>' + (l ? "Undang-undang" : "Statute") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Kode di halaman ini" : "Coded on this page") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Putusan Mahkamah Agung yang menyebutnya" : "Supreme Court decisions naming it") + "</th><th>" + (l ? "Per lima tahun" : "By five-year period") + "</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
    L2.stat.forEach(function (st) {
      var bars = st.per.map(function (p) {
        var w = Math.max(2, Math.round(80 * p[1] / maxv));
        return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px"><span class="g-mono" style="width:70px">' + p[0] + "\u2013" + String(p[0] + 4).slice(2) + '</span><span style="display:inline-block;height:9px;width:' + w + 'px;background:' + (p[0] + 4 < st.year ? "#C8BCB1" : "#8F5E12") + '"></span><span class="g-mono">' + p[1] + "</span></div>";
      }).join("");
      h += "<tr><td><b>" + esc(t(cn[st.cc] || [st.cc, st.cc])) + "</b><br>" + esc(l ? st.id : st.en) + '<br><span class="g-note">' + (l ? "berlaku sejak " : "in force since ") + st.year + "</span></td><td>" +
        st.codes.map(function (c) { return esc(l ? c[3] : c[2]) + ": <b>" + esc(c[1]) + "</b>"; }).join("<br>") + "</td><td>" + st.hits + '<br><span class="g-note">' + st.site + (l ? " di basis data kami" : " in our database") + '</span><br><button type="button" class="g-btn" data-occlaw="' + st.k + '" aria-pressed="' + (S.law === st.k) + '">' + (l ? "Tampilkan" : "Show them") + "</button></td><td>" + bars + "</td></tr>";
    });
    h += "</tbody></table></div>";
    if (S.law) {
      var st = L2.stat.filter(function (x) { return x.k === S.law; })[0];
      var ds = C.d.filter(function (d) { return (L2.dec[d[0]] || []).indexOf(S.law) >= 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return String(b[3]).localeCompare(String(a[3])); });
      h += '<div class="g-card" style="margin-top:12px"><h3>' + esc(l ? st.id : st.en) + ' <span class="g-note">(' + ds.length + ')</span></h3><ul style="padding-left:18px;line-height:1.5;max-height:420px;overflow:auto">' +
        ds.map(function (d) { return '<li><a href="/court-decisions/d/' + d[0] + '/">' + esc(d[1]) + '</a> <span class="g-note">' + esc(d[3] || "n.d.") + (d[7] === "C" ? (l ? " · belum diperiksa" : " · unchecked") : "") + "</span></li>"; }).join("") + "</ul></div>";
    }
    h += '<p class="g-note">' + (l ? "Cara membaca: sebuah putusan dihitung jika istilah pencarian untuk undang-undang tersebut muncul dalam teks lengkapnya di situs Mahkamah Agung (E-Library Filipina; Nepal Kanoon Patrika); ini berarti undang-undang itu disebut, belum tentu diterapkan. Batang abu-abu adalah periode sebelum undang-undang berlaku (di Nepal, Undang-Undang Kerja Luar Negeri 1985 yang lebih lama memakai nama yang sama). Cakupan E-Library lebih lengkap untuk tahun-tahun terakhir, dan 2025\u201329 baru mencakup sebagian periode. Indonesia belum dapat ditampilkan karena putusan Mahkamah Agungnya belum dikumpulkan."
                                  : "How to read it: a decision counts if the search term for the statute occurs in its full text on the Supreme Court's own site (the Philippine E-Library; Nepal Kanoon Patrika), so the statute is named, not necessarily applied. Grey bars are periods before the statute came into force (in Nepal the older Foreign Employment Act of 1985 has the same name). The E-Library is more complete for recent years, and 2025\u201329 is a partial period. Indonesia cannot be shown yet because its Supreme Court decisions have not been collected.") + "</p>";
    return h;
  }
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("[data-occby],[data-occrow],[data-occord],[data-occlaw]"); if (!b) return;
    if (b.hasAttribute("data-occlaw")) { var k2 = b.getAttribute("data-occlaw"); S.law = S.law === k2 ? null : k2; }
    else if (b.hasAttribute("data-occord")) S.ord = b.getAttribute("data-occord");
    else if (b.hasAttribute("data-occby")) { S.by = b.getAttribute("data-occby"); S.row = null; }
    else { var k = b.getAttribute("data-occrow"); S.row = S.row === k ? null : k; }
    render();
  });
  new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["lang"]});
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", render); else render();
})();
